claims.text: Many reviewers report that the product lengthens and thickens their lashes over time.
Several reviewers find the product non-irritating and suitable for sensitive eyes or skin.
Some reviewers report eye irritation or burning when the product gets in their eyes.
A few reviewers experienced packaging problems such as a broken wand, cracked cap, or broken rim.
Some reviewers note they have not yet noticed any change after a few weeks of use.
